§11.2.5 Line Charts

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

charts-line-charts · charts types

✅ Normative

A line chart MUST be rendered with one value per series per x position: one row per x position, one column per series, each series named by its legend entry or by its direct label at the line's end. A value printed at a point MUST be copied; every other value is read against the axis. Wiggles between x positions are not positions.

  • A line labeled directly at its end is a named series: the printed name at the line's end heads its column (see Labels§11.1.2).
  • An x position the axis does not label is labeled by its axis value (see Cover Every Data Point§11.1.1).
  • A labeled trend, average or reference line adds no column (see Multiple Charts and Reference Ink§11.1.3).
  • Scenario lines that share one drawn curve early on have identical values in those positions — correct, not a copying slip.

✅ Sample — health-workforce-2024_p45

Five lines named by their direct labels over eleven labeled years, nothing printed on the lines: 5 × 11 = 55 values, each the line's centre at the year read against the 5-unit grid (tolerance 0.05 where the vertex sits near a gridline, 0.1 where it does not). Columns follow the direct labels from top to bottom. The value-axis title follows the table. The axis also prints a stray . after 2022, at a position with no line; it is not given a row.

✅ Sample — energy-outlook-2025_p20

Three scenario lines named and valued by their end labels (High: 11 Tcf, +150% …). The name part heads each column; the rest of the label, printed at the 2040 end of the line, is that line's 2040 value, copied whole — the Low label's second line (from 2024 levels) included. The Low line ends near 8.5 on the axis, but its printed 8 Tcf wins. Every other value is an estimate on the 2-unit grid; the shared early curve gives all three series the same values in 2024 and 2026, and Mid and Low the same values in 2028 and 2030. The rows are the 9 printed ticks (2024–2040, every second year): 3 × 9 = 27 values.
